$comment: The only houses the nightly may walk (ADR 0135; audit of PR #349, finding 1.3). The walk signs in with real session tokens and uploads a screenshot of every page, so a house outside this list is refused as cannot_check before anything is opened: an id typed into a workflow_dispatch input or a secret must not turn a real restaurant's books into a 30-day public artifact. The gateway exposes no slug (organizations.service.ts getBranchesForUser selects id, name, city, chain_id), so the check is this committed id list AND the branch name the gateway returns starting with 'Sim '. Measured 2026-09-16 with a read-only PostgREST select on production: restaurants?select=id,slug,name&slug=like.sim-*. Re-measure before adding a house; never add one by name.
